## API Reference

### Binance Web3 API (1.0.0)

Cross-chain wallet, market, trading, transaction, and B402 payment APIs for the Binance Web3 API platform.

- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/supported/chain` — Get Supported Chains
- `POST /api/v1/dex/market/price` — Get Token Price
- `POST /api/v1/dex/market/price-info` — Get Token Trading Info
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/candles` — Get Candles
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/search` — Search Token
- `POST /api/v1/dex/market/token/basic-info` — Get Token Basic Info
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/advanced-info` — Get Token Advanced Info
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/hot-token` — Get Hot Token List
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/holder` — Get Holders Ranking
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/top-trader` — Get Top Traders
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/token/top-liquidity` — Get Top Liquidity Pools
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/trades` — Get Token Trades
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/memepump/tokenDevInfo` — Get Token Dev Info
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/portfolio/supported/chain` — Get Portfolio Supported Chains
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/portfolio/overview` — Get Address Portfolio Overview
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/portfolio/recent-pnl` — Get Address Recent PnL
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/portfolio/token/latest-pnl` — Get Address PnL for Specific Token
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/portfolio/dex-history` — Get DEX Trade History
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/leaderboard/list` — Get Leaderboard
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/address-tracker/trades` — Get Tracked Trades
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/platforms` — Get RWA Token Issuance Platforms
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/price` — Get RWA Token Price
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/search` — Search RWA Token
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/underlying-profile` — Get RWA Underlying Info
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens` — Get RWA Token List
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/rwa/underlying-market` — Get RWA Underlying Market Data
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/supported/chain` — Get Aggregator Supported Chains
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/approve-transaction` — Get ERC-20 Approve Transaction
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote` — Get Aggregated Quote
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/swap` — Build Swap Transaction
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote-and-swap` — Quote and Build Swap Transaction (Flash API)
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/swap-instruction` — Build Solana Swap Instructions
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/history` — Get Transaction Status
- `POST /api/v1/dex/aggregator/order/submit` — Submit RFQ Order
- `GET /api/v1/dex/aggregator/order/{orderId}` — Get RFQ Order Status
- `GET /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/supported/chain` — Get Transaction Supported Chains
- `GET /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/gas-price` — Get Gas Price
- `GET /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/block-height` — Get Latest Block Height
- `POST /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/gas-limit` — Get Gas Limit
- `POST /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/simulate` — Simulate Transactions
- `POST /api/v1/dex/pre-transaction/broadcast-transaction` — Broadcast Transactions
- `GET /api/v1/dex/post-transaction/orders` — Get Broadcast Orders
- `GET /api/v1/dex/balance/supported/chain` — Get Wallet Supported Chains
- `GET /api/v1/dex/balance/all-token-balances-by-address` — Get All Token Balances by Address
- `POST /api/v1/dex/balance/token-balances-by-address` — Get Token Balances by Address
- `GET /api/v1/dex/post-transaction/transactions-by-address` — Get Transactions by Address
- `GET /api/v1/dex/post-transaction/transaction-detail-by-txhash` — Get Transaction Detail by Hash
- `POST /api/v1/defi/data/position/list` — Get DeFi Positions
- `POST /api/v1/defi/data/protocol/list` — List DeFi Protocols
- `POST /api/v1/defi/data/protocol/detail` — Get Protocol Detail
- `POST /api/v1/defi/data/investment/list` — List DeFi Investments
- `POST /api/v1/defi/data/investment/detail` — Get Investment Detail
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/deposit` — Build DeFi Deposit Transaction
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/redeem` — Build DeFi Redeem Transaction
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/lp-add` — Build LP Add Transaction
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/lp-add/calculate` — Calculate LP Add Paired Amounts
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/lp-remove` — Build LP Remove Transaction
- `POST /api/v1/defi/transaction/claim` — Build DeFi Claim Transaction
- `POST /api/v2/b402/supported` — Get B402 Supported Configurations V2
- `POST /api/v2/b402/verify` — Verify B402 Payment V2
- `POST /api/v2/b402/settle` — Settle B402 Payment V2
- `POST /api/v1/b402/supported` — Get B402 Supported Configurations V1
- `POST /api/v1/b402/verify` — Verify B402 Payment V1
- `POST /api/v1/b402/settle` — Settle B402 Payment V1
- `GET /api/v1/dex/market/wss/auth/token` — Get WebSocket Auth Token

### Binance Web3 WebSocket Streams (1.0.0)

Real-time on-chain data streaming over WebSocket for the Binance Web3 API platform.

- `POST /w3w@onchainos@pub@price@{chainId}@{contractAddress}` — Price Stream
- `POST /w3w@onchainos@pub@tx-data@{chainId}@{contractAddress}` — Market Stats Stream
- `POST /w3w@onchainos@pub@tx@{chainId}@{contractAddress}` — Real-Time Trades Stream
- `POST /w3w@onchainos@pub@candles@{bar}@{chainId}@{contractAddress}` — Candlestick Stream
